experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 3000 sequencing: GSM4431926: WT_Rep2 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
project_name: Mitochondrial HSP90 is involved in cellular physiology
study_title: Mitochondrial HSP90 is involved in cellular physiology
description: Illumina HiSeq 3000 sequencing: GSM4431926: WT_Rep2 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted and purified using the RNA Clean & Concentrator kit (Zymo Research, R1013) according the manufacturer's protocol. On-column DNAse I treatment was performed to eliminate genomic DNA contamination. RNA-seq libraries were prepared using the TruSeq Stranded mRNA library prep kit (Illumina, RS-122-2101) and analyzed by paired-end poly(A) RNA sequencing with an illumina HiSeq system.
